query:
WITH updated AS (
               UPDATE projects p SET template_id = $2
               WHERE p.id = $1
                 AND ($2::uuid IS NULL OR EXISTS(
                     SELECT 1 FROM project_templates t
                     WHERE t.id = $2 AND t.owner_team_id = p.owner_team_id))
               RETURNING 1
           )
           SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM projects WHERE id = $1) AS "project_exists!",
                  EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM updated) AS "updated!"
